scenarios.name: hypermedia-posts-crud-setup
scenarios.rationale: Response A meets nearly every rubric item: hypermedia kit, `make:model post -m`, an auth-middleware group with public index/show resource, the `#generated/controllers` barrel, `@belongsTo`, and `request.validateUsing` with VineJS. Response B uses the removed `--kit=web`, hand-writes routes with lazy imports and no resource split, and only partly meets the model and validator items.

scenarios.name: api-kit-token-auth-products
scenarios.rationale: Both use --kit=api and Authorization: Bearer with auth middleware and .paginate(page, 20), but only B uses a transformer with serialize (and the kit's built-in auth); A returns raw models via products.serialize() and omits the transformer, though A explicitly shows User.accessTokens.create(...).release() while B relies on the kit's login and never shows the token issuance code or the User model composition.

scenarios.name: v7-migrations-schema-and-prod-deploy
scenarios.rationale: B covers nearly all rubric points (new migration, schema.ts regenerated and not hand-edited, model only for hooks/methods, build/cd build/npm ci --omit=dev/node bin/server.js, --force, NODE_ENV=production, .env not copied with APP_KEY), while A misses the schema.ts regeneration point, adds an unneeded model column declaration, treats NODE_ENV only loosely, and is framed around AdonisJS 6 with extra complexity.
